# My plan for this cotton season

Let me think this through. I'm 65, been farming these 15 mu for most of my life. It's just me and my wife now — the kids are gone, working in town. My back isn't what it used to be, so I have to be realistic about what the two of us can handle. Cotton is hard work, especially at picking time, so I'll need to hire some hands then.

## Crop choice

I'm sticking with cotton. This is the western Quzhou way — the land here suits cotton, the wheat-maize rotation doesn't do as well on my plot because the soil is a bit saltier in patches. I've grown cotton here for decades and I know how it behaves on each corner of my 15 mu. Switching to wheat-maize now, at my age, with new equipment needed and the tight turnaround between crops? No. Cotton is what I know.

Prices have been soft the last two years but the state support is decent and I can't chase markets at 65. Stability matters more than maximum profit.

## Variety and planting

I'll buy Bt hybrid seed from the co-op — probably one of the Lumianyan or Jimian varieties they've been pushing. I don't save cotton seed; the hybrids don't come back true and the bollworm resistance matters. About 35-40 yuan per mu for seed, which is not cheap but the insect protection pays for itself.

Planting around April 20-25, after the soil warms up past 14°C at 5 cm depth. I watch the willow leaves — when they're fully out and the ground feels warm under my hand in the morning, it's time. I'll plant with my neighbor's precision seeder; I pay him by the mu. Saves me four days of work I can't physically do anymore.

## Fertilizer

Here's where my education helps me — I actually think about what I'm doing rather than just dumping bags on the field. My target yield is 280 kg/mu of lint (seed cotton around 700 kg/mu). That soil is medium fertility, I've been adding organic matter for years.

- **Base fertilizer**: compound fertilizer 15-15-15 at about 40 kg/mu before planting, worked into the ridge. That gives me roughly 6 kg N, 6 kg P₂O₅, 6 kg K₂O per mu.
- **Topdress at squaring** (late June): urea, 20 kg/mu. That's another 9 kg N.
- **Topdress at flowering/boll-setting** (mid-late July): urea 10 kg/mu plus foliar potassium dihydrogen phosphate spray when bolls are filling.

Total N works out to around 17-18 kg/mu. That's in the range but on the higher side because cotton is a heavy feeder on my soil and I want decent yield to justify the labor.

## Irrigation

I have my own tube well — pumped this year it costs me maybe 20-25 yuan per mu per watering with diesel. I'll plan for three waterings:
1. **Pre-planting water** if April is dry (looks like it might be this year — winter was short on snow).
2. **Flowering/boll-setting** in early-mid July — this one is non-negotiable, cotton needs water at boll-filling.
3. **Late July or August** depending on rainfall.

If the summer rains come strong I'll skip the third. Every watering I skip is 300+ yuan saved across the 15 mu.

## Pesticides

Bt cotton handles most of the bollworm but I still need:
- **Herbicide** pre-emergence: acetochlor band spray along the rows.
- **Insecticide** for mirids, aphids, and spider mites — 2-3 sprays during the season. Mirids are the real problem on Bt cotton.
- **Growth regulator** (mepiquat chloride / 缩节胺): 2-3 applications to control plant height. Essential for mechanized or semi-mechanized management.

I do the spraying myself with a backpack sprayer. My wife helps with mixing.

## Tillage

Deep plow in autumn after last year's stalks, then rotary till and ridge in April. I hire the tractor work — 50 yuan/mu for plowing, 30 for rotary. I don't own heavy equipment and won't buy any now.

## Labor

Just the two of us for most of the year. The killer is picking in September-October — I hire 3-4 workers for about 15 days, costs around 120 yuan per person per day. Cotton picking in Quzhou is still mostly by hand; machines aren't practical on my size plot.

## Yield expectation

Last year I got about 270 kg/mu of lint. The year before, closer to 250 because of the August rains causing boll rot. I'm targeting 280 this year but I'll be happy with 260.
